context.transcript:
M
I'm pleased to inform you today about a new employee
benefit. The management team knows that many of you have
had problems commuting to work by train, so our company
president has agreed to provide a free shuttle service to and
from the train station for all employees. All you need to
do is show the driver your employee ID card each time you
board. Interested employees should fill out the survey that
was sent to you by e-mail no later than Friday. That way we'll
know how many buses we'll need
